caveats: This uses cached top-k logprob distributions from real GGUF inference, not persisted full-vocabulary penultimate logits.
The 100-example set is deterministic bootstrap resampling because the cached balanced manifest has 36 usable rows.
The score uses SemanticEnergyDetector.compute_energy() directly; repeated-response semantic clustering is not available in this cache.
evaluation_design: Sample with replacement from 22 correct and 14 incorrect live SOTA telemetry rows using numpy default_rng(42), yielding 50 factual and 50 hallucination examples.

field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. complete: with AUROC value.
field_principles.logit_source: Records which logit source was used (gguf/cached/small-model/synthetic-realistic).
field_principles.semantic_energy_real_auroc: AUROC on real or representative LLM logits. Expected lower than 1.0 (realistic).
field_principles.semantic_energy_real_validated: True if AUROC >= 0.60 on real-distribution logits.

honest_verdict: complete: SemanticEnergyDetector validated on cached live GGUF top-k logprob vectors; AUROC=0.685200 on 100 bootstrapped examples.
logit_vector_construction: Flatten each generated token's cached top-k logprob dictionary in descending logprob order. Full vocabulary logits were available during live llama.cpp generation but only compact top-k logprob distributions were persisted.
precondition_cache_check: results/ contains live/logprob artifacts including live_sota_balanced_telemetry_manifest_1480.jsonl and arm_ebm_logprob_telemetry_manifest_1556.jsonl.
precondition_gguf_check: Local HuggingFace hub contains unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF and unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF cache directories.
title: Semantic Energy real-distribution GGUF top-k logprob validation
